# Release notes template

Copy this skeleton into the GitHub release body. Keep the title to a version and
a one-line result, for example `v0.13.0 — Codex fixture comparison`. State what
was measured, not what it implies about other jobs.

```markdown
## What changed

- One line per added or changed recipe, with a link to its directory.
- Note any corrected claim or boundary, and what evidence changed it.

## Verification

- Fixture and check used, for example `recipes/<recipe>/verify.sh`.
- Pinned harness, model, and add-on versions where a run is reported.
- Runs per arm and the pass count, or "no benchmark in this release".

## Limitations

- What this release does not show. A single fixture is a compatibility result,
  not a universal ranking.

Get one recipe a week by email through the
[Software Sausage newsletter](https://softwaresausage.com/?source=referral&utm_campaign=github-recipes#newsletter).
Signup is confirmed by email and every issue has a one-click unsubscribe.

Disclosure: Software Sausage is our product.
```
